> [!NOTE]
> **What this PR changes:**
>
> - New page `content/docs/support/provider-support-policy.md` states the provider long-term support policy: covered providers, duration, what an LTS release does and doesn't contain, and a summary table.
> - The support landing page gains a "Provider support policy" card linking to it.
> - The provider-version FAQ answer is rewritten from "no formal long-term support" to the new policy, and gains a "Learn more" link to the page.
>
> The wrongness that would block a reader here is a support commitment the docs state but the company doesn't actually make — a wrong provider list, duration, or set of covered fixes. Each new statement was checked against the policy page itself, the support menu and link targets, and the page was read end to end for structure.
>
> **Review confidence:**
>
> | Dimension | Level | Notes |
> | :--- | :---: | :--- |
> | mechanics | HIGH |  |
> | facts | MEDIUM | This page *is* the policy, so most of its statements are Pulumi's own commitment and can't be checked against an outside source — only their internal consistency was. Someone who owns the policy should confirm the provider list and the 12-month window. |
> | coherence | HIGH |  |
> | cross-sibling consistency | HIGH |  |

### ⚠️ Check these before approving

| ID | Where | Finding |

Not yours to check for correctness; just confirm you're happy with the repetition, or ask the author to drop the standalone section and let the summary table carry the detail. Moved off the author's card because a reader still gets the right answer either way. |
| **F3** | `content/docs/support/provider-support-policy.md` L34-47 | The "Engine support" heading reads like a new topic, but its one sentence restates an exclusion already in the bulleted "does not contain" list just above it ("Compatibility with newer versions of the Pulumi engine…"). Confirm that's the intended emphasis, or ask for it to be folded into that bullet. Moved off the author's card for the same reason as F2 — presentation, not correctness. |
